releaseNotes:
• Android Default Fitness Manager (Health Connect): Integrated androidx.health.connect:connect-client to read Steps, Cadence, Distance, Speed/Pace, Elevation & Floors, Active Calories, Sleep Sessions, and Exercise GPS Routes directly from Android's default Fitness Manager.
• Persistent Hardware Sensor Fallback: Daily step baseline persisted across app restarts with automatic calorie calculation and last-known GPS fix.
• Icon-First Telemetry Tiles: Updated all 9 telemetry feature tiles to display leading icons before text for clear scannability.
